content.value: The rate at which a body cools is proportional to the difference between the temperature of the body and the constant temperature of the medium surrounding the body. A body of temperature $1 0 0 ^ { \circ } \mathsf { C }$ is placed at time $\iota = 0$ in a medium the temperature of which is maintained at $4 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ At the end of 10 minutes the body has cooled to a temperature of $9 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$
(i) What is the temperature of the body at the end of 30 minutes?
(ii) When will the temperature of the body be ${ 5 0 } ^ { 0 } { \mathrm { C } } ?$
